channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Cognizant Classic 2026: Final-round tee times, pairings and how to watch
item.description: The final round of the Cognizant Classic is Sunday on the Champion Course at PGA National. Here's a look at tee times, pairings and how to watch.

item.title: Shane Lowry again with chance to win Cognizant, co-leads with Austin Smotherman
item.description: Going out early Saturday to avoid inclement weather, Lowry shot 63 and Smotherman 69 to both reach 13 under at PGA National.

item.title: 'It's you': After fairway standoff, going second works for Smotherman
item.description: Smotherman and Ewart standoff on the 18 fairway, then each take their shot

item.title: Tiger Woods and Jordan Spieth, Part 4: The Grand Slam
item.description: Tiger Woods breaks down being the youngest player to complete the career Grand Slam in 2000 at The Open at St. Andrews. Watch the fourth episode of "Tiger Woods: 30 Years of Influence."

item.title: Tiger Woods, 30 Years of Influence: Full Spieth interview
item.description: Tiger Woods, 30 years after turning professional, discusses all aspects of his career in an interview series with some of today's top players, beginning with Jordan Spieth.

item.title: Smotherman stoked for Sunday opportunity at PGA National
item.description: Austin Smotherman finished strong Saturday to put himself in position for his first PGA Tour victory at the Cognizant Classic. Hear from the optimistic co-leader at PGA National.

item.title: Can Lowry finally seal the deal at Cognizant Classic?
item.description: Shane Lowry often plays well at PGA National and has another chance to win the Cognizant Classic. "Golf Central Postgame" looks back at some recent highs and lows, and hears from the 54-hole co-leader.

item.title: Aussies Green and Lee grab 54-hole LPGA lead in Singapore
item.description: Australia's Hannah Green and Minjee Lee share the 54-hole lead at the LPGA's event in Singapore, the HSBC Women's World Championship. Watch third-round highlights and hear from the co-leaders.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Cognizant Classic, Round 3
item.description: Extended highlights from the third round of the PGA Tour's 2026 Cognizant Classic, where scores were low and Shane Lowry and Austin Smotherman share the lead at PGA National.

item.title: Moving Day: Lowry rises to the top at Cognizant
item.description: Shane Lowry shot 63 Saturday to move into a share of the 54-hole lead at the Cognizant Classic. Anna Jackson and Steve Marino discuss his chances to win, in Penske's Moving Day.
